description: Kajabi Course Automation - Workarounds for course creation using blueprints, webhooks, and bulk operations. Note: Kajabi API v1 does not support direct course creation.

tools.name: kajabi_generate_course_blueprint
tools.short_description: Generate detailed course blueprint with modules, lessons, assessments, pricing structure
tools.description: 📋 COURSE BLUEPRINT GENERATOR: Creates detailed course structure blueprint that can be used as a guide to manually create courses in Kajabi. Generates comprehensive JSON with modules, lessons, assessments, pricing, and step-by-step implementation instructions. Perfect for planning course structure before creation or sharing templates with team members.

course_description.description: Brief course overview describing what students will learn (required)

num_modules.description: Number of course modules to create (default: 5, range: 1-20)

lessons_per_module.description: Number of lessons in each module (default: 3, range: 1-10)

include_assessments.description: Add quizzes/assessments after each module (default: true)

returns.description: Course blueprint with structure, modules, lessons, implementation instructions, and checklist

parameters.course_description: Master SEO, social media, email marketing, and paid ads
Weekly training, monthly workshops, and community support

tools.name: kajabi_setup_course_webhook
tools.short_description: Create webhook for course automation: enrollment, emails, certificate delivery
tools.description: 🔗 WEBHOOK AUTOMATION: Creates webhook to automate course-related actions like auto-enrollment, welcome emails, certificate delivery, and integration with Zapier/Make.com. Essential for automating workflows that Kajabi API doesn't support directly. Enables real-time automation when students purchase, complete lessons, or finish courses.

webhook_url.description: Your webhook endpoint URL that will receive events (required)

events.description: List of events to monitor (optional, defaults to purchase/completion events)

course_id.description: Specific course ID to monitor (optional, monitors all courses if not specified)

returns.description: Webhook configuration with automation examples and integration options

tools.name: kajabi_bulk_enroll_from_csv
tools.short_description: Bulk enroll multiple members into course from CSV data with dry-run preview
tools.description: 📊 BULK ENROLLMENT: Enrolls multiple members into a course from CSV data. Perfect for course launches, migrations, or promotional giveaways. Includes dry-run mode to preview before executing. CSV format: email,name,custom_field1,custom_field2. Automatically finds members by email and grants course access.

course_id.description: Target course ID to enroll members into (required)

csv_data.description: CSV string with member data. First row must be headers. Must include 'email' column (required)

offer_id.description: Specific offer/payment plan to associate with enrollment (optional)

dry_run.description: Preview mode - shows what would happen without executing (default: true)

returns.description: Enrollment summary with success/failure counts and details

tools.name: kajabi_get_course_templates
tools.short_description: Get pre-built course templates with structure, modules, lessons, pricing recommendations
tools.description: 📚 TEMPLATE LIBRARY: Returns pre-built course templates for common course types (online courses, memberships, coaching programs, mini-courses). Each template includes recommended structure, module count, lesson plans, pricing models, and content ideas. Use these as starting points for generate_course_blueprint.

category.description: Filter by template category (optional, returns all if not specified)

returns.description: Course templates with structure recommendations and usage instructions
